Source: Forecasting Research Institute, Longitudinal Expert AI Panel, “Wave 12: Safety Policies”, first released 5 October 2026. [Original report](https://leap.forecastingresearch.org/reports/wave12). Retrieved 8 October 2026.

The report footer says “Content licensed under CC-BY.” and links [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The question, necessary shared instrument context and four published table cells in `leap-wave12-catastrophe2050.json` are a selected, structured derivative of that report. They retain CC BY 4.0 attribution and are not relicensed under data/CC0. No endorsement by the Forecasting Research Institute or its collaborators is implied.

Changes: decoded the public page serialization without executing it; manually transcribed and structured only the selected instrument and four aggregate cells; retained source percentages as decimal strings; added explicit date roles, unknowns and discrepancy flags. The offline reader validates this ledger and emits exact decimal probability strings and version identifiers. It is not an HTML extractor or respondent-level reproduction.

The manifest separates the SHA-256 of the exact 600,997-byte downloaded original HTML body from the SHA-256 of this curated JSON derivative. Original HTML is not vendored. A hash identifies content; absent original bytes in CI, validation cannot independently authenticate that the source said the recorded text. Documentary source review and offline fixture checks are distinct.

The permission here covers this report-derived selection only. It does not establish permission to acquire or redistribute unpublished respondent data, personal forecasts or rationales, other linked works, images, code, or a broader archive. The question's embedded quotation/attributions stay intact as source instrument context. No report-wide copy, models, scripts, source notebooks or respondent profiles are included.

Between-respondent quartiles are not confidence intervals. Group overlap and effective sample sizes are unknown. General methodology describes reweighting for Expert/Public and no reweighting for Superforecaster, but the Wave 12 cell-specific procedure was not verified; AI Risk Expert weighting is unknown. The reported expert n157 and category-count total149 remain unresolved. No pooled forecast or summed unique-participant count is produced.
